name: Harinath Reddy Anugula
headline: AI Engineer
intro: I’m an AI engineer building production-ready GenAI, machine learning, and data systems. I turn complex information into practical tools—from agentic copilots to reliable document and video pipelines.

experience.title: Data and AI Engineer II
experience.summary: Leads enterprise Generative AI delivery with Azure OpenAI, Azure ML, Cognitive Services, scalable RAG pipelines, and LangChain/LangGraph agentic architectures. Built and optimized ChromaDB embedding and semantic retrieval pipelines to improve response accuracy and reduce hallucinations in production.

projects.name: Underwriter Ally — Bond & Surety AI Copilot
projects.summary: Built a Graph RAG copilot that helps underwriters draft coverage and answer submission questions across about 300 strategy guides, quick references, and exclusions. Piloted with up to 50 underwriters; evaluated against about 100 golden-set conversations and the prior plain-RAG chatbot, with underwriter feedback. A multi-agent system combines memory, planning, LangGraph/MCP tool orchestration, and Neo4j knowledge graphs, reaching 85–90% accuracy on complex underwriting queries.

projects.name: AI-Based Clause Review Engine
projects.summary: Shipped a production document-review pipeline processing 100–200 insurance slips per day (about eight pages each) to identify clauses and flag typos or missing words against original wording. Orchestrated document processing, per-page clause identification using three sequential LLM calls, and clause comparison with Temporal. Added Kibana and Dynatrace dashboards and alerts for processing errors and failed calls, plus CI/CD for deployment.

projects.name: A/B Testing Framework for AI Agents
projects.summary: Built an Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway experimentation layer for testing prompt and agent changes in development. Routes new prompts to selected users or a percentage of requests without redeploying agents; provisioned reproducible gateway and routing configuration as Terraform infrastructure-as-code for enterprise deployment.

projects.name: STTM — Informatica Source-to-Target Mapper
projects.summary: Engineered an MCP-based agentic system that generates source-to-target data lineage from Informatica XML mappings. Turns complex ETL logic into structured, interpretable lineage steps and supports scalable processing of large enterprise XML mapping files.

experience.title: AI Engineer
experience.summary: Implemented end-to-end MLOps pipelines, including CI/CD, Docker-based containerization, and scalable cloud deployment for AI systems.

projects.name: NLP-Based Invoice Evaluation System
projects.summary: Built and integrated an NLP system to evaluate and classify attorneys’ daily work entries. Trained a custom named-entity-recognition model to extract task entities from free text and developed fuzzy matching to distinguish billable from non-billable activities, improving task identification and automating invoice evaluation.

projects.name: Risk Quantification for Project Tenders
projects.summary: Built PySpark and Databricks pipelines, orchestrated with Azure Data Factory, to transform raw data into gold-standard datasets. Developed Random Forest, XGBoost, and Decision Tree models for risk prediction and probabilistic modeling, achieving 80–88% accuracy in identifying high-risk tenders. End-to-end preprocessing, feature engineering, training, and evaluation reduced manual risk analysis effort by 35%.

projects.name: AI Assistant for Videos
projects.summary: Developed a multimodal assistant using LLaVA-13B to process text, images, and video, produce concise video summaries, and answer contextual questions. Managed ChromaDB vector databases for semantic search and RAG, and deployed scalable Flask API endpoints on AWS.

projects.name: Shop-Floor Safety Surveillance
projects.summary: Designed a real-time manufacturing safety monitoring system. Trained custom YOLOv8 object detection to check helmets, gloves, jackets, and other required gear; built facial recognition to identify workers without required equipment; integrated live video streams for continuous detection and violation alerts.

projects.name: LLM for Customer Support
projects.summary: Fine-tuned FALCON 7B, 13B, and 40B models for electronics customer support. Built a RAG pipeline for relevant, factual responses, FastAPI serving endpoints, and CosmosDB-backed domain knowledge retrieval. Optimized training and inference on NVIDIA A100 GPUs.

projects.name: Video Anonymization Pipeline
projects.summary: Engineered an Airflow workflow to anonymize video: segmented videos into frames, detected and blurred faces, reconstructed anonymized output videos, and stored them in AWS S3. Containerized components with Docker Compose and orchestrated them through Airflow DAGs; AWS Redshift was also part of the project stack.
